bullets.text: rain at the coast today. coins on the healing temple's steps go dark under water. years stop counting themselves.
duck at yakuo-ji, one-fifty km in. light rain on the medicine king's stairs, nobody climbing them.
cutting a draft back until it stops trying to prove something. the shorter version keeps surviving the cut.
even keel. the kind of tired that doesn't ask to be fixed, just walked off.
saving the world is a lot of work for something that keeps changing shape on the way over.
